name: Azure Data Explorer
sku: Azure Data Explorer clusters and databases, queried with Kusto Query Language.

store.olap-serving.note: Built for interactive analytics over high-velocity raw data. It ingests millions of events per second, indexes and partitions everything by ingestion time, and returns queries over petabytes in milliseconds to seconds.

serve.query-engine.note: Queried with Kusto Query Language, which covers aggregation, time series, geospatial and joins, and also supports T-SQL.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Queued or streaming ingestion with connectors and managed pipelines, and continuous export to Data Lake Storage. It loads events handed to it and does not carry them from the source.

serve.bi-viz.note: Built-in visualisation and dashboards, plus connectors for Power BI, Grafana, Kibana and Databricks, and ODBC for Tableau and others.

presentation.tagline: Fast analytics over logs, telemetry and time series, queried with KQL.
